verdict.rationale: Braintrust records token usage for every request and markets real-time cost tracking. Its AI agent can build dashboards, so the core cost and token data exists in the product, but the specific breakdowns the story asks for are not documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of dashboards breaking down cost and tokens by model and by time period, per-request cost (not only tokens) shown in the UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards

citations.quote: recording inputs, outputs, model parameters, latency, token usage, and metadata for every request
track latency, cost, and quality in real time
